sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-7,200 (levels 1-13). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Eternal Night unlocked. 4.8k spikes: weapon 4.8k at Kinetic Dash. Ultimate (Eternal Night) is available from Kinetic Dash.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 10400 souls (~10.4 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Stalker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Kinetic Dash completes 3,200 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Kinetic Dash completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Rapid Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Kinetic Dash completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Kinetic Dash completes 4.8k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Swift Striker
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Kinetic Dash completes 1,600 souls on. Upgrade of Rapid Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Kinetic Dash completes 4.8k weapon in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Kinetic Dash
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 18 to 46% weapon damage.

items.name: Sprint Boots
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Lifestrike, 4000 souls (~4.0 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 7,200-27,200 (levels 13-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Rend T3, Stalker's Mark T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Rend, bonus damage) grows from 98.5 to 123. 4.8k spikes: vitality 4.8k at Lifestrike.

items.name: Bullet Lifesteal
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Lifestrike completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Lifestrike completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Lifestrike
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (4,000 to 6,400 invested, crossing the 4.8k, 6.4k tiers): bonus 20 to 42 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Melee Lifesteal (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.
items.legacy_note: Maxed Rend counts as a heavy melee, so it heals you and slows what it hits.

items.name: Battle Vest
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 6,400 to 8,000 invested: bonus 42 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.caption: Builds toward the 6.4k weapon tier, which Point Blank completes 2,400 souls on.
items.why: imminent: Point Blank completes 6.4k weapon in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Point Blank
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 5,600 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 46 to 62% weapon damage.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 8,000 to 11,200 invested: bonus 62 to 74% weapon damage.

items.name: Hollow Point
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: swap_candidate)

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 27,200-40,000 (levels 29-33). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Bloodscent T3.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 74 to 86% weapon damage.

items.name: Silencer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 20,800 to 27,200 invested: bonus 86 to 100% weapon damage.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Vampiric Burst? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.
sections.desc: Dying after Vampiric Burst? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Stalker.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry turns and out-shoots you.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage keeps ticking on you, like Infernus burn or Seven's ult.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ult or stun you can see coming.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes stop you chasing or getting out.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Stuns keep stopping you before you can finish them.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 33,600 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Leech
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.
items.legacy_note: Sell Stalker for this, or Trophy Collector if it's gone.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 19,200 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes weapon from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 100 to 115% weapon damage.
